outcome_evidence: The oven is closed at frame 0 in left_ego_image. The robot approaches and gradually adjusts its gripper near the oven’s upper/front handle area (frames 50, 150, 250 and 330 in image and left_ego_image; wrist_image shows the nearby door and handle). At frames 380–399, the door still appears closed in left_ego_image, with no visible opening of the oven cavity. Completion is unconfirmed: the episode ends with the gripper near the handle, rather than showing a clearly completed failed acquisition or an unsuccessful pull after established possession. The slow approach and adjustments alone do not establish a local failure.
